lines: esteban_bloodmage
Colleagues, a professional question. When {player} takes a hit and walks it off, as they always do, should we intervene?
liam_suncleric
Nah, mate, if they're breathing fine and the colour's good, I sit them down for five minutes and a cup of tea.
nicolas_bloodmage
I check the colour twice, ya. But {player} holds their side all the way back sometimes, causas, I've seen it.
esteban_bloodmage
Then two of us have noticed and nobody has acted. That's a poor record for three medics, and I include myself.
liam_suncleric
Fair point, Esteban, though you'd have had them on a table with your sleeves rolled up by now, admit it.
esteban_bloodmage
I would have examined them properly, yes. That's what the word medicine means, Liam, despite what the Blue Mountains taught you.
nicolas_bloodmage
Oe, both of you, before you start. Let's just ask {player} how they feel.

options.text: I'm fine, stop fussing, all three of you.
reply: liam_suncleric
Ha, fair enough, that's a patient who's going to live. Kettle on, then.
esteban_bloodmage
Noted, under protest. I'll check them tomorrow regardless.

options.text: Since you ask, it does hurt. Somebody have a look.
reply: nicolas_bloodmage
Ya, I knew it, thank you for saying it, pata. Sit down, I'll look.
esteban_bloodmage
And I'll observe, quietly, with only minor comments.

options.text: Whoever's least smug gets to look.
reply: liam_suncleric
That rules Esteban out, then, sorry, mate.
esteban_bloodmage
It rules everyone out, I'd say. Nicolas, you're the least objectionable, go on.

silent: liam_suncleric
Not answering, eh? That's a yes, they hurt. Nicolas, you're up, mate.

lines: sebastian_bloodmage
Chicos, it's simple, I do the meat, everybody else stands back and admires. That's how a grill works.
yiannis_paladin
Ela, Sebastian, the meat is nothing without the fish, and the fish is mine. Children, tell him.
tarek_templar
And neither of you is cooking anything until I've checked the water you washed it in. That stream is a disgrace.
sebastian_bloodmage
Che, Tarek, you check water like my grandmother checked boyfriends, very suspicious and never satisfied.
tarek_templar
Your grandmother was right, then, about both. Meanwhile {player} hasn't eaten since this morning, and that's the real problem here.
yiannis_paladin
Panagia mou, the child is starving while three old men argue about the stove. Shame on all of us.
sebastian_bloodmage
Fine, fine, first plate to {player}, and then we go back to arguing about who's best. Nobody touches my grill.
minh_chronomancer
Four in the morning, and here we are again, the three of us. I believe this is a pattern, gentlemen.
owen_cultist
Night people, see, it's in the bones. Eight years on the M4 and you never sleep proper again, mind.
ivan_warrior
Eleven years on Route 13, and I sleep perfectly well. I'm awake because Owen is humming.
owen_cultist
Duw, was I? Sorry, bach, I don't always notice. Chapel hymns, they creep in when it's quiet.
minh_chronomancer
It's fine, it helps me keep time. Owen hums, I count, Ivan complains, and {player} sleeps through all of it.
ivan_warrior
{player} sleeps like a passenger at the end of the line. Mouth open, very peaceful, I'm jealous.
owen_cultist
Leave them be, now then. Somebody in this camp ought to get a full night, and it won't be us three.
emre_rogue
Marco, have you noticed {player} carries a knife and no picks? One day they'll try it on a chest, my friend, a kitchen knife on a chest.
marco_paladin
Madonna, I've thought the same. The lock will cry, Emre, I'll hear it from the road.
emre_rogue
We have to teach them, it's a moral duty. Somebody who treats a lock like that will eventually treat a door like that.
marco_paladin
Allora, I teach the patience, you teach the listening, and {player} learns to put the knife away first.
emre_rogue
Agreed, though your patience is slower than my listening, and my listening is very slow.
marco_paladin
Piano, piano, my friend, that's the whole lesson. The lock was never in a hurry, only the knife.

options.text: Fine, teach me. No knives, I promise.
reply: emre_rogue
Tamam, a student at last. Sit down, and be quiet, that's the first lesson.
marco_paladin
And the second is also be quiet. You'll be good, I think, eventually.

options.text: It opened, didn't it?
reply: marco_paladin
It opened, yes, the way a window opens when you throw a chair through it.
emre_rogue
We'll try again in a week, when the lock has stopped grieving.

silent: emre_rogue
Silence, which in a student is promising. We start tomorrow, whether you agree or not.

lines: rhodri_knight
Owen, butt, I've been teaching {player} to say Llanfairpwllgwyngyll and it's a disgrace, isn't it.
owen_cultist
Now then, Rhodri, nobody says the whole thing on the first go. Took me till I was twelve, and I'm from Barry.
rhodri_knight
Barry, that's barely Wales, mind, that's Cardiff's back garden. Ponty's the real thing.
owen_cultist
Duw, here we go. You valleys boys and your hills, all rain and no chips.
rhodri_knight
We've got chips, we've got rugby, and we've got a choir in every chapel. {player}, back me up here, butt.
owen_cultist
Don't drag the poor soul into it. They can't even say the name of the village yet.
adrian_templar
Callum, I gave the plan once, clearly. Front holds, back heals, nobody wanders off. And then you wandered off.
callum_venomancer
Mate, there was a snake, a beauty, a new one, nobody's ever seen it. I couldn't just leave it there.
adrian_templar
There were also four bandits, which everybody had seen, and {player} was in the middle of them.
callum_venomancer
And {player} was fine, mate, they handled it, they always do. I was gone for thirty seconds.
adrian_templar
Forty one seconds. I count, Callum, it's what I did for twenty one years, and it was forty one.
callum_venomancer
Strewth, you actually counted, didn't you? Fair enough, I'll give you that, that's dedication.
adrian_templar
It isn't dedication, it's the minimum. {player}, you were there, tell him.

options.text: Adrian's right, Callum. Stay with the group.
reply: adrian_templar
Thank you, {player}, fairly said. That's all I wanted.
callum_venomancer
Yeah, alright, I hear you. I'll stay put, mostly, unless it's a really good snake.

options.text: I was fine. But next time, take me with you to see the snake.
reply: callum_venomancer
Ha, now that's a deal, mate! You and me, snake hunting, Adrian can count.
adrian_templar
Hostia, now there are two of them. I'll start counting for both of you, then.

options.text: Sort it out between yourselves.
reply: adrian_templar
Fair enough, it's ours to settle. Callum, forty one seconds, and we'll leave it there.
callum_venomancer
Forty one, mate, fine, I'll get it down to twenty.

silent: callum_venomancer
Nobody's backing you, Adrian, see? Forty one seconds of my life well spent, mate.
adrian_templar
Silence isn't agreement, Callum. I'll be keeping count.

lines: ryan_warlock
I'll say it, lads, since nobody else will. People here are no better than at home. Same greed, worse teeth.
pavlo_knight
And why do you think that is, Ryan? Because you've decided it already, so every greedy man proves you right.
ryan_warlock
Or because I spent twelve years watching people sell their own grandmothers, and I'm good at spotting the type.
pavlo_knight
Then spot this one, Ryan. {player} walks into other people's trouble every week for nothing, and never asks for a fee.
ryan_warlock
True enough, I've watched it. That's either a very good person or a very bad investor.
pavlo_knight
In my experience, class, the two often go together. You might try it some time.
ryan_warlock
I might, teacher, I might. Don't hold your breath, mind, I've got a reputation to keep.
leif_primalist
Quiet night, this. Yep, the three of us, nobody talking, and {player} doing all the talking. Works for me.
haruto_runemaster
I find it restful. {player} talks, and the three of us listen, like a good audience at a recital.
matias_reaper
On the bus it was the same, ya. One talks, forty listen, and the forty are happy.
leif_primalist
Huh, that's true, I never thought about it like that. Somebody has to fill the air, I guess, and it's not going to be me.
haruto_runemaster
Nor me, I'm afraid. I spent twenty years making one mark a day and saying nothing.
matias_reaper
Then we are the passengers, cabros, and {player} is the radio. It's good, ya, a good bus.
sebastian_bloodmage
Chicos, four of us at one fire, and we all speak Spanish, and nobody can understand anybody else. Que hermoso, chicos.
orlando_witchdoctor
Ay, papi, you speak Argentinian, that's singing, not Spanish. Puerto Rico speaks it properly, mi amor.
cristobal_knight
Properly, he says? Hermano, you drop half the letters, it's like listening to a radio in a tunnel!
nicolas_bloodmage
And Chileans, pata, you talk so fast even Chileans need subtitles. Cachai, weon, all that.
cristobal_knight
Oye, that's Chilean poetry, Nicolas. Peruvians just say causa to everything and hope for the best.
orlando_witchdoctor
Mi gente, enough, {player} is sitting there looking at us like we're a telenovela with no subtitles.
sebastian_bloodmage
Then {player} learns one word tonight, che, and it's the most important one, which is asado.

options.text: Asado. Now feed me.
reply: sebastian_bloodmage
Perfecto, a fluent speaker already! First plate, chicos, the student has earned it.
cristobal_knight
One word and you're already more Argentinian than me, que verguenza.

options.text: Teach me something from all four of you.
reply: orlando_witchdoctor
Ay, mi amor, a diplomat! Okay, one word each, and nobody fights.
nicolas_bloodmage
Mine is chevere, pata, it means good, and it fixes most things.

options.text: I understood all of it, actually.
reply: cristobal_knight
All of it? Hermanos, we've been insulting each other in front of a witness!
orlando_witchdoctor
Then you heard what he said about my letters, and you'll defend my honour, papi.

silent: nicolas_bloodmage
{player} says nothing, causas. Smart, that's how you survive a table like this one.

lines: marcus_stormbringer
So the interesting thing about tonight's sky, team, is the pressure gradient, which, sorry, I'll keep it short, is fascinating.
berat_tinker
Marcus, family, you're beautiful, come here, I'm hugging you now, nobody stop me.
dan_warrior
Give over, the pair of you. One of you's explaining the clouds and the other's hugging the bloke explaining the clouds.
berat_tinker
Dan, my dear, you need a hug more than anyone here. Your jaw is so tight I can hear your molars from here.
dan_warrior
My molars are fine, ta. {player}, tell them I don't need a hug, love, before he gets any closer.
marcus_stormbringer
Statistically, Dan, you're the one who'd benefit most. I could show you the numbers, sorry, if you like.
dan_warrior
You lot are a nightmare. Right, one hug, and if either of you mentions it tomorrow I'm off home.
giorgi_primalist
Bakyt, my friend, look at {player} walking. Like a lamb on the first day, all legs, very brave.
bakyt_hunter
Jakshy, a good lamb. It doesn't know the mountain yet, but it walks anyway. This is the best kind.
giorgi_primalist
In Kazbegi we put the young ones in the middle of the flock, so the wolves find the old ones first.
bakyt_hunter
In the Tian Shan the same. Then we are the old ones, Giorgi, and {player} walks in the middle.
giorgi_primalist
Good, then this is decided. Old shepherds on the outside, my friend, and the lamb safe inside.
silas_rogue
A little game, ladies and gents. I read each of you from across the fire, and you tell me if I'm wrong.
diego_tinker
Me first, me first, my friend, read me, I'm an open book, a very messy book with pictures!
silas_rogue
Diego, you've taken apart four things today and put back three. The fourth is in your left pocket.
diego_tinker
That's, okay, that's frightening, yes, it's a hinge, I'll put it back, sure, sure, later.
tomas_warrior
Don't read me, Silas, I'm not interested in being read. I check my knots, I go to bed.
silas_rogue
You already did, Tomas, twice, and you checked {player}'s straps when they weren't looking. Kind of you.
tomas_warrior
Somebody has to, crew, they tie a knot like a man who's never fallen. Don't make it a thing, Silas.
tarek_templar
Adrian's doing it again, {player}. Standing at the edge with his hands behind his back, waiting for permission.
adrian_templar
I'm not waiting for anything, Tarek. I'm standing, which is allowed, and I'm counting heads.
tarek_templar
You counted them ten minutes ago, habibi. There are still the same number of heads, I promise you.
adrian_templar
Then I'll count them again properly, to be thorough. It isn't a crime to be thorough.
tarek_templar
It's a crime to let the food go cold. {player}, tell him to sit, he listens to you more than me.

options.text: Adrian, sit down. There's a place next to me.
reply: adrian_templar
Well, if you insist, then I'll sit, properly. Thank you, {player}.
tarek_templar
You see that, {player}? Three years I've been trying that. Here, bread, both of you.

options.text: Let him count. Tarek, just save him a plate.
reply: tarek_templar
Fine, a plate saved, and I'll guard it like a well. He'll come, he always does.
adrian_templar
I will come, eventually, once I've finished. Thank you for the plate, Tarek.

silent: tarek_templar
Nobody's going to make you, then, Adrian. So I'm just going to put the bread next to you and walk away.
adrian_templar
That's very sneaky, Tarek. Fine, I'm sitting, and only because the bread is warm.

lines: cristobal_knight
Esteban, two men from Valparaiso, and you've never once come to a fiesta. Not one, hermano, it's a scandal.
esteban_bloodmage
I spent nineteen years sewing up what came out of those fiestas, Cristobal. I've seen enough of them from the other end.
cristobal_knight
Ay, that's dark, even for you. You need to dance, it would do you good, doctor's orders.
esteban_bloodmage
I'm the doctor, so the orders are mine, and they say no. You, on the other hand, should stop running into burning things.
cristobal_knight
Somebody has to run in, Esteban, or there's nothing left for you to sew up afterwards.
esteban_bloodmage
That's a fair point, and an irritating one. {player}, I'd appreciate it if you didn't encourage him.
giorgi_primalist
Three mountain men at one fire, my friends. In Kazbegi this would need a toast, and a long one.
bakyt_hunter
In the Tian Shan also, jakshy. But first tea, because a toast without tea is only noise.
pasang_primalist
Butter tea, then, I made plenty. Nobody likes it, but it's very good for you at altitude.
giorgi_primalist
This is terrible, Pasang, really terrible. I'll have another cup, to be polite.
bakyt_hunter
Look at {player}, friends, drinking it with a brave face, like a young herder at his first feast.
pasang_primalist
Ramro, a good sign, that face. On day four they'll ask for it, and then they'll be one of us.
mateo_starcaller
Chiquillos, look, that's the one I've named the Lantern, the bright one low in the south. Isn't it beautiful, po?
minh_chronomancer
It's also moving, Mateo, slowly, on a heading of about two hundred. I've been tracking it for an hour. I think it's a planet.
marcus_stormbringer
Sorry, both of you, but there's a band of high cloud coming in from the west in about forty minutes, so enjoy it while it lasts.
mateo_starcaller
Ay, Marcus, you always do this, you bring the clouds with you like a bad uncle.
minh_chronomancer
He doesn't bring them, he forecasts them. Although he does seem pleased when he's right.
marcus_stormbringer
Only a little pleased, team. {player}, back me up, I said cloud by midnight, didn't I?

options.text: You did, Marcus. Sorry, Mateo.
reply: marcus_stormbringer
Thank you, {player}, vindicated, and I'll try not to mention it again until breakfast.
mateo_starcaller
Ya, ya, fine, but the Lantern will still be there tomorrow, po, and so will I.

options.text: I wasn't listening, I was looking at the Lantern.
reply: mateo_starcaller
You see, chiquillos? A true observer, {player} looked up! There's hope for this party.
minh_chronomancer
Copy that, one vote for the sky, none for the weather. Marcus, you're outnumbered.

options.text: Minh, is it a planet or not?
reply: minh_chronomancer
I'll confirm by dawn, {player}. Sequence first, then conclusions.
mateo_starcaller
If it's a planet, I'm naming it after all four of us, po, and the cloud gets nothing.

silent: minh_chronomancer
No answer from {player}, which on my frequency means carry on. So, carry on, everyone.

lines: iker_guardian
Champions, it's decided, tomorrow there's a match in that field, five a side, and Adrian's refereeing!
adrian_templar
I agreed to referee, Iker, I didn't agree to a crowd. And I'll be applying the laws properly, everyone should know that now.
rhys_ranger
I'll watch from the trees, if that's all right, with Tegan. She's not keen on shouting, and there'll be a lot of it.
iker_guardian
No, no, Rhys, you're in goal, you've got the best hands here! You catch a hawk, you can catch a ball.
adrian_templar
He doesn't have to play if he doesn't want to, Iker. Nobody's forced onto my pitch.
iker_guardian
Fine, fine, the referee has spoken. {player}, you're on my team, obviously, unless you want to lose.

options.text: I'm on your team, Iker. Let's win.
reply: iker_guardian
Aupa, that's my champion! Tomorrow we train at dawn, then we win at noon.
adrian_templar
And I'll be watching you both very closely, properly, with the whistle.

options.text: I'll keep goal with Rhys in the trees.
reply: rhys_ranger
Oh, tidy, thanks, cariad. We'll keep score from up there, quietly.
iker_guardian
Two substitutes in a tree, champions, that's a first. Fine, but you're cheering.

options.text: I'll help Adrian referee.
reply: adrian_templar
A linesman, at last. Thank you, {player}, I'll explain offside tonight, properly, twice.
iker_guardian
Two referees on one pitch? Ostia, we'll never get a goal past either of you.

silent: iker_guardian
No answer means yes, champion, you're on my team. Training at dawn!

lines: driss_shaman
Mateo, my friend, I've guided caravans by the stars for twenty eight years. Tonight I'd like to hear them from a man who knows their names.
mateo_starcaller
Ay, Driss, that's the nicest thing anybody's said to me in a year, po. But these aren't my stars, I'm naming them as I go.
driss_shaman
Then name one for the caravans, please, a bright one in the south. Something a lost traveller could follow home.
mateo_starcaller
Done, ya, that one there, the bright one over the Flats. I'll call it the Guide, and it goes on the map tonight.
driss_shaman
Shukran, my friend. {player}, you're our witness, so the name is official.
rhodri_knight
Three Welshmen at one fire, boys, isn't it lush? We need a song, a proper one, all together now!
rhys_ranger
Not too loud, Rhodri, please, Tegan's only just settled. She's not a big fan of male voice choirs.
owen_cultist
Now then, we can do it quiet, mind. Calon Lan, low and slow, the way they sing it at a funeral.
rhodri_knight
A funeral, Owen? Duw, I wanted a party, not a wake. Fine, low and slow, but I'm doing the harmony.
rhys_ranger
Tegan's watching {player}, boys. I think she wants to know if they can sing.
owen_cultist
Go on, bach, have a go with us. Nobody's judging, except the hawk, and she judges everybody.

options.text: Fine, but I don't know the words.
reply: rhodri_knight
Nobody knows the words, butt, that's half of Welsh singing. Just hum and look moved.
rhys_ranger
Tegan's settled, look. That's a good sign, that is.

options.text: I'll listen. You three sing.
reply: owen_cultist
Fair enough, an audience, tidy. Right, boys, from the top, softly.
rhodri_knight
An audience of one and a hawk, the best crowd I've had in years.

silent: rhodri_knight
Shy, is it? Never mind, the three of us will carry it. From the top, boys.

lines: dan_warrior
Four of us who did proper shifts, round one fire. Steel, trams, rigging, and Jun-seo's shipyard. Nobody here's had a lie in for thirty years.
ivan_warrior
Eleven years on Route 13, I woke at three every morning. I still wake at three, here, with no tram.
junseo_reaper
Five in the morning for me, the end of the night shift. My body still wants to clock off at five.
tomas_warrior
Load out at two in the morning, every tour. I still check the rigging in my sleep, crew.
dan_warrior
And {player} sleeps till the sun's up, look at them, never done a night shift in their life, the lucky sod.
junseo_reaper
It's okay, it's easier than the factory for everyone. Let them sleep, somebody should.
leif_primalist
Nice stand of trees over there, Eino. Pretty old, I'd say.
eino_barbarian
Joo, very old. Leave them standing.
leif_primalist
Yep, that's what I was thinking too. Didn't want to say it first.
eino_barbarian
Good, then we agree, and that's enough talking for today.
leif_primalist
{player} keeps looking at us like we're broken. We're fine, I promise, this is a conversation.
eino_barbarian
A long one, for us. My throat is tired.
thiago_paladin
Gente, three healers at one fire, so let's settle it. Who here is worst at looking after themselves?
liam_suncleric
Easy, mate, Nicolas. He's told everybody not to drag him if he goes down, which is the worst rule I've ever heard.
nicolas_bloodmage
Oe, Liam, you haven't slept a full night in fifteen years, pata, and you're judging me?
thiago_paladin
And I've sat up with somebody else every night since I got here, so we're all terrible, uai. Good, at least we're honest.
liam_suncleric
Here's a better question, team. Who's going to make {player} drink some water before bed? They never do.
nicolas_bloodmage
All three of us, causas, at once. They can't say no to three medics.

options.text: Fine, I'll drink the water. Happy?
reply: thiago_paladin
Very happy, meu irmao, that's the best patient I've had all week.
liam_suncleric
Good on ya, now all of us drink some, that's an order, team.

options.text: Only if all three of you go to sleep early.
reply: nicolas_bloodmage
Ya, okay, that's fair, a deal. The patient negotiates, causas.
thiago_paladin
Uai, outplayed by our own patient. Fine, early to bed, all of us.

silent: liam_suncleric
Not answering, eh? That's a no, then. Thiago, get the water, mate.

lines: cristobal_knight
Hermanos, there's a fire in the next valley, I can smell it. We go now, we put it out, simple.
diego_tinker
And I've got a machine that sprays water, my friends, nearly finished, sure, sure! Twenty minutes and she'll be perfect!
henrik_mage
Neither of you has asked what's burning, how big it is, or which way the wind is going. Those are the only questions that matter.
cristobal_knight
Henrik, I fought wildfires for twelve years, I know how to read a fire. You read numbers.
henrik_mage
Then read it aloud, please, and I'll write it down. Diego, your machine stays here until somebody's checked the pressure.
diego_tinker
Ay, the pressure is fine, mostly, probably. {player}, tell him, she only exploded once, and it was a small one.
haruto_runemaster
Jun-seo, a moment. You cut too quickly. The knife is ahead of your mind again.
junseo_reaper
Aigo, I know, I know. My hands want to finish, it's the line, nine years of it.
haruto_runemaster
Then put the knife down for a breath. Look at the wood. Decide the cut. Only then, the knife.
junseo_reaper
Okay, okay, slowly. Look, decide, then cut. It's like learning to walk again.
haruto_runemaster
It is exactly that. {player}, you're watching. Notice how much better that cut was.
